title: Exact constant finite free presentations after flat sheaf scalar extension
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $R$ a commutative ring, $R_{\mathcal C}$ its constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $B$ a sheaf of commutative $R_{\mathcal C}$-algebras. For every $R$-module $P$, let $P_{\mathcal C}$ be the constant module sheaf [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor] and put $E_B(P)=B\otimes_{R_{\mathcal C}}P_{\mathcal C}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then the functor $P\mapsto P_{\mathcal C}$ is exact and has the canonical finite-power identifications $(R^s)_{\mathcal C}\cong(R_{\mathcal C})^s$ for every finite $s\geq0$. The functor $E_B$ has natural identifications $\beta_s:E_B(R^s)\xrightarrow{\sim}B^s$ characterized locally by $b\otimes(x_i)\mapsto(bx_i)_i$, with inverse $(b_i)\mapsto\sum_i b_i\otimes e_i$. For every matrix $A:R^m\to R^n$ over $R$, these identify $E_B(A)$ with the matrix $A_B:B^m\to B^n$ whose entries are the images of those of $A$ in $B$. If $B$ is flat over $R_{\mathcal C}$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], every specified exact sequence $0\to R^m\xrightarrow{A}R^n\xrightarrow{v}P\to0$ with $m,n$ finite induces the exact sequence $0\to B^m\xrightarrow{A_B}B^n\xrightarrow{E_B(v)\beta_n^{-1}}E_B(P)\to0$. Independently of flatness, every specified isomorphism $R^r\xrightarrow{v}P$ with $r$ finite induces the isomorphism $B^r\xrightarrow{E_B(v)\beta_r^{-1}}E_B(P)$. All finite-power and matrix identifications include rank zero.
